title: TipTrip
summary: An AI-assisted travel companion designed to organize trips with less friction, including planning, local guidance, kosher needs and Shabbat-aware experiences.
problem: Travel planning is fragmented across maps, notes, search, messaging and generic travel tools. The product goal is to bring planning and trip context into one focused mobile experience.
build: Product concept, mobile architecture, interaction design, AI-assisted travel flows, destination guidance and a design system tailored for a premium mobile experience.

title: DevOps Final Project

build: A hands-on project around infrastructure, automation and deployment practices.

title: Reliable Networking Project
summary: A networking-focused implementation exploring reliable transport behavior, congestion concepts and protocol logic.
problem: Understand reliability and congestion through implementation rather than theory alone.
build: A practical networking project with transport logic and protocol behavior.

title: Wedding Invite Manager

title: PostFlow Elite

build: A workflow-oriented tool aimed at making publishing operations faster and more structured.
